prompt: Make exactly one subtle skeptical-expression edit to this 2x2 upper-half eye sheet, starting from raw v3. Preserve original face geometry, eye size, pupil positions, centered forward gaze, hair, soft palette, skin shading, background, and exact open / half / closed / duplicate-open cell order. Do not shift pupils left or right; both pupils must stay centered, forward-facing, same position and size in every open-eye cell. No side gaze, eyeroll, crossed eyes, head rotation, or changed framing. Make only a small brow and eyelid expression adjustment across all four cells, keeping brow placement consistent between phases: raise the viewer-left brow by about one additional native pixel (about two native pixels total above neutral), and gently lower or flatten the viewer-right brow by about one native pixel. Add slight questioning narrowing to the open upper lids. This should read a little more skeptical than raw v3 while staying natural and restrained. No angry inward V, no scowl, no high cartoon arches, no exaggeration. Keep both brows visible. Preserve current half-blink coverage and fully closed lower-left cell; alter only expression details. Keep original soft pixel-art palette and contrast; do not sharpen, blur, airbrush, repaint skin, alter hair/neck/background, crop, resize, or add labels/text. Return complete 2x2 sheet.
grid_order: open / half blink / closed blink / duplicate open (row-major)
visible_deviations: Eyes remain forward-facing. Viewer-left brow appears slightly higher; viewer-right brow flatter/lower. Brow and lid shift is subtle.
native_quality_limits: Exact +1 native-pixel adjustment and total +2 vs neutral need parent confirmation at native 64x35 size; large sheet view cannot establish pixel-level magnitude. Keep eye size and color close to raw v3.
